image_description: A medium shot of an older man wearing academic regalia, specifically a dark blue or purple gown with red velvet trim and a doctoral tam (cap). He is holding a rolled diploma or scroll. The background shows wooden pews, suggesting a university hall or church setting. Other graduates are visible in the blurred background.

The gown exhibits clear bilateral symmetry with a central vertical opening revealing the white shirt/cravat underneath.
The fabric hangs loosely around the torso and arms, successfully hiding the underlying body shape.

The front edges of the gown are clearly defined, framing the chest area.

The figures in the background left are indistinct blobs with no clear facial features or structural integrity, appearing as 'melting' forms rather than people.
The doctoral tam sits somewhat unnaturally on the head; the tassel connection point is ambiguous and the geometry of the cap's top panel seems slightly warped relative to the head angle.
